'''Chief of Detectives''' was a [[Police rank|rank]] used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The Chief was in charge of the [[detective division]] and would hand out assignments to his [[Detective/Legends|detectives]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Unidentified Chief of Detectives|individual]] who held the post assigned Detectives [[Chal Tozr]] and [[Gwad Raatu]] to investigate the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]] in [[Fellowship Plaza]].
